title: Garmin Run Marathon Series Philippines 2026 Review: SM MOA Tech-Brand Race
seo_title: Garmin Run Philippines 2026 Review | SM MOA Pasay Race
meta_description: The Garmin Run Marathon Series Philippines 2026: October 25 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay. 21K, 10K, 5K from HyveSports with registration open.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this Garmin-branded run offers three distances with registration open via HyveSports. A tech-brand Philippine race at Manila Bay's iconic waterfront complex.
verdict: The Garmin Run Marathon Series Philippines brings the global GPS-watch brand's running series to SM Mall of Asia — Manila Bay's landmark waterfront venue. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open, produced by HyveSports. Garmin's brand presence typically means tech-enhanced race features (GPS-mapped courses, data-rich results) and premium race merchandise. October in Manila is the tail of the wet season, with improving conditions as the dry season approaches. A solid tech-brand Philippine half marathon at a proven venue.

sections.heading: Garmin at SM MOA
paragraphs: Garmin's global run series has expanded across Asia, and the Philippine edition at SM Mall of Asia provides a waterfront, flat-course venue with excellent transport links. [1] HyveSports handles local production. Expect Garmin-branded race tees, finisher medals, and data-focused race results.
